title: Scholar's Exteriors
description: This is a datapack of a custom Tardis Exterior imported from the Scholar Whooves Mod
body: This is a Datapack for the Dalekmod, and it adds in all the Scholar's Exteriors of the Tardises. There are some subtle connections to two of the Tardises, the Built, and the 5th Scholar's Tardis. I hope you enjoy my blue boxes!
